about: The sections that answer each situation in SITUATIONS.md, by the live post's section ids (S001 = its first heading; LIVE-TOC.json gives each id's heading in the post as it was on 2026-11-16 02:12 UTC). 'right' sections answer it; 'also' sections answer part of it and count as right too. Written from the live post's text before any new contents was drafted, and kept out of the readers' view. A reader's pick counts by its section id, so a renamed or moved section still counts.
